found.description: The requirement says alive supervision starts only after the checks pass, but does not require it to start when they pass. CON-SUP-102 specifies that it starts when the checks have passed.
found.requested_change: Require alive supervision to start when the start-up integrity checks pass.

found.description: The requirement mandates a named function and SysTick interrupt handler. STK-SUP-001 requires detection of stopped tasks and does not allocate this software implementation.
found.requested_change: Replace the implementation prescription with a sourced system-level supervision obligation, or remove it if already covered.

found.description: The independent watchdog timeout is described only as "suitable", so a verifier cannot determine whether it passes. CON-SUP-106 specifies 100 ms.
found.requested_change: State the source-specified independent watchdog timeout.

found.description: The requirement specifies a 2 ms to 40 ms refresh window, while CON-SUP-106 specifies reset for refreshes earlier than 6 ms or later than 12 ms.
found.requested_change: Correct the window boundaries to agree with CON-SUP-106.

found.description: The requirement stops watchdog servicing when a code 8 report causes the latch. CON-SUP-137 says the report is not a fault detection under CON-SUP-121 and watchdog servicing continues as for any start-up; the report counts only toward the latch rule.
found.requested_change: Align watchdog servicing for a third code 8 report with CON-SUP-137 while retaining the specified latch behavior.

found.description: The requirement sets a 50 ms maximum for a 1 MiB run-time code check, while CON-SUP-108 specifies completion within 11 s. Processing one 1 KiB segment per 10 ms cycle as required by SYS-MEM-005 also cannot complete that pass in 50 ms.
found.requested_change: Use the source-specified full-pass limit and reconcile it with the segment-per-cycle requirement.

found.description: "A small share" of each control cycle has no measurable acceptance limit. CON-SUP-108 specifies at most 0.5 ms of processor time per control cycle.
found.requested_change: State the source-specified processor-time limit.

found.description: The requirement requests a software reset within 100 ms after a start-up configuration fault. SYS-SAFE-010 latches the safe state for that fault and SYS-SAFE-014 prohibits requesting a software reset while it is latched; CON-SUP-115 requires the latch.
found.requested_change: Remove or correct the reset obligation so it agrees with the configuration-fault latch and reset prohibition.

found.description: The requirement latches at five detections of a fault code. CON-SUP-117 requires latching at the third detection, and CON-SUP-140 retains a separate count for each code.
found.requested_change: Use the source-specified third-detection threshold.

found.description: The requirement prescribes a uint8_t array indexed by fault code. CON-SUP-140 requires separate per-code counts but does not prescribe their representation.
found.requested_change: State the required per-code counting behavior without prescribing an unsupported data structure.

found.description: The requirement says the latch is never lost under any circumstances, but CON-SUP-117 and SYS-SAFE-013 require it to clear on a power-on reset.
found.requested_change: Specify latch retention across the applicable resets and its clearing on power-on reset.

found.description: The requirement stores every start-up reset-cause message in the fault history. CON-SUP-111 requires the cause in a start-up message, while CON-SUP-134 defines the history returned by GET FAULTS as fault reports; it does not authorize storing every reset message there.
found.requested_change: Remove the unsupported history obligation or identify authoritative input defining how reset messages belong in the fault history.

found.description: The requirement specifies 9600 baud, whereas CON-SUP-007 specifies 115200 baud for the diagnostic line.
found.requested_change: Correct the baud rate to the value in CON-SUP-007.

found.description: The transmission deadline is stated as "within 10 of the detection" without a unit. CON-SUP-112 specifies 10 ms.
found.requested_change: State the deadline with the source-specified unit.

found.description: The requirement mandates AES-128 encryption of every fault report. STK-SUP-012 asks for reports with a code, entity and timestamp, and CON-SUP-112 specifies their serial format; the cited source does not justify encryption.
found.requested_change: Remove the encryption obligation or provide an approved source and reconcile it with the specified report format.

found.description: The requirement prescribes a ring buffer and advancement of head and tail pointers. CON-SUP-113 requires the last eight reports, but does not prescribe this data structure or update mechanism.
found.requested_change: Specify retention of the eight most recent reports without prescribing the internal buffer implementation.

found.description: The maximum request length is "TBD", so the acceptance boundary cannot be verified. CON-SUP-138 specifies at most 32 ASCII characters before the line feed.
found.requested_change: Replace TBD with the source-specified request-length limit.

found.description: The requirement allows 25% processor time, while STK-SUP-014 limits the supervisor to 10%; CON-SUP-114 defines the measurement window and conditions.
found.requested_change: Correct the processor-time limit to the stakeholder's 10% limit.

found.description: The specified governance package hi/sys-req/governance.json is absent. Its use cases, scope and assumptions cannot be assessed or included in the coverage matrix.
found.requested_change: Provide the governance package and assess each use case, its scope and assumptions against the inputs and requirements.

found.description: STK-SUP-003 and CON-SUP-104 require detection of missing or out-of-order checkpoints at the end of each control cycle; CON-SUP-122 and CON-SUP-123 define the reported entity. No flow-detection requirement is present.
found.requested_change: Add the cycle-end flow detection and entity-selection obligations, including one report per affected cycle.

found.description: STK-SUP-007 and CON-SUP-107 require configuration integrity checking. SYS-MEM-002 compares CRCs, but no requirement detects the configuration integrity fault when they differ.
found.requested_change: Specify detection of configuration integrity fault code 6 and its detectable instant.

found.description: CON-SUP-106 specifies a 100 ms independent watchdog timeout; SYS-WDG-001 states only a suitable timeout.
found.requested_change: Specify the required 100 ms timeout.

found.description: SYS-WDG-002 specifies a 2–40 ms refresh window, whereas CON-SUP-106 specifies reset for refresh earlier than 6 ms or later than 12 ms.
found.requested_change: Correct the window watchdog boundaries to match CON-SUP-106.

found.description: SYS-MEM-006 requires a full 1 MiB run-time code pass within 50 ms; CON-SUP-108 specifies 11 s and one 1 KiB segment per 10 ms control cycle.
found.requested_change: Correct the full-pass limit to the approved value and reconcile it with the segment rate.

found.description: SYS-MEM-007 limits the run-time check to a small share of each cycle; CON-SUP-108 sets a measurable maximum of 0.5 ms per cycle.
found.requested_change: Specify the 0.5 ms processor-time limit per control cycle.

found.description: SYS-SAFE-007 latches at five detections, while CON-SUP-117 and CON-SUP-140 require latching at the third detection of a fault code.
found.requested_change: Correct the latch threshold and reconcile the related reset and watchdog obligations with it.

found.description: SYS-SAFE-030 requests a reset after a start-up configuration fault, while SYS-SAFE-010 and SYS-SAFE-014 latch the safe state and prohibit that reset, as required by CON-SUP-115.
found.requested_change: Remove or correct the conflicting reset obligation.

found.description: SYS-SAFE-009 requires the safe-state latch never to be lost under any circumstances, conflicting with SYS-SAFE-013 and CON-SUP-117, which clear it at power-on reset.
found.requested_change: Limit retention to the resets and power conditions specified by the inputs.

found.description: SYS-DIAG-001 specifies 9600 baud, while CON-SUP-007 requires 115200 baud. This also affects the transmission-time assumptions in CON-SUP-143.
found.requested_change: Correct the serial line rate and reassess the diagnostic timing obligations.

found.description: SYS-DIAG-019 requires AES-128 encryption of every fault report, without support in STK-SUP-012, and conflicts with the specified serial report form in CON-SUP-112.
found.requested_change: Remove the unsupported encryption obligation or obtain an approved decision that reconciles it with the interface.

found.description: SYS-DIAG-003 requires transmission within 10 of detection without a unit; CON-SUP-112 specifies 10 ms.
found.requested_change: State the time unit and verify the exception against CON-SUP-121.

found.description: SYS-DIAG-013 leaves the maximum request length as TBD, although CON-SUP-138 specifies 32 ASCII characters. SYS-DIAG-015 refers to absent SYS-DIAG-014 for overlength lines.
found.requested_change: Specify the 32-character limit and the required ERR response for overlength lines, including the concurrent-answer exception.

found.description: CON-SUP-143 requires a fault report raised during an answer to wait only until the current line feed, then precede further answer lines; answer lines are limited to 40 characters. SYS-DIAG-017 addresses only transmissions both waiting and does not specify these obligations.
found.requested_change: Add the line-boundary priority and answer-line length obligations.

found.description: SYS-PERF-001 permits 25% processor time; STK-SUP-014 permits no more than 10%, measured as defined by CON-SUP-114.
found.requested_change: Correct the normal-operation processor-time limit to 10%.

found.description: SYS-TEST-002 cites STK-SUP-016, but the supplied stakeholder-needs input ends at STK-SUP-015.
found.requested_change: Remove or correct the unsupported trace and retain the applicable STK-SUP-015 and CON-SUP-116 links.

found.description: SYS-SUP-011 prescribes a specific function and SysTick interrupt, neither established by CON-SUP-006 nor justified by another supplied source.
found.requested_change: Remove the unsupported implementation prescription or provide an approved source and rationale.

found.description: SYS-RST-002 stores every reset cause in fault history, while SYS-SAFE-020 defines that history as the fault reports held for GET FAULTS; CON-SUP-111 requires sending and making the reset cause readable but does not require it as a fault report.
found.requested_change: Clarify or remove the reset-cause storage obligation so it does not contaminate the specified fault-report history.

found.description: The supplied inputs and requirements do not identify whether a controlled shutdown is applicable or define its behavior. The missing governance package cannot establish an exclusion.
found.requested_change: Obtain a scope decision for shutdown and specify its behavior if applicable; track the missing decision as an open point.

found.description: The workproduct is marked draft and records a product-decisions input hash different from the task's current input hash. Its revision and agreement status against the current inputs are not established.
found.requested_change: Reconcile the set with the current input baseline and identify the resulting revision, affected parties and approval status.
